C0284.title: Equifax Fined $700 Million for Massive Data Breach
C0284.summary: In 2017, U.S. credit reporting agency Equifax suffered a massive data breach exposing the Social Security numbers and other personal information of approximately 143 million consumers. In July 2019, Equifax agreed to pay roughly $700 million to settle with the U.S. Federal Trade Commission.
